content.text:
Yes, but **first check which kind of $5,000 credit you have**. That determines whether AI inference is covered.

If these are standard **DigitalOcean Startups core credits**, DigitalOcean says they **do not cover GPU Droplets, dedicated inference, or third-party serverless models hosted outside DigitalOcean**, including commercial OpenAI and Anthropic models. Its exclusions leave DigitalOcean-hosted serverless models eligible, but I’d confirm your specific award before running a large workload. GPU credits are a separate benefit you can apply for. [DigitalOcean Startups credit rules](https://www.digitalocean.com/startups)

For a portable AI project, I’d use the credits this way:

1. **Experiment with DigitalOcean-hosted open-weight models through serverless inference.** The text endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so you can keep the provider URL and model name configurable. DigitalOcean lists models such as Qwen, DeepSeek, Llama, and gpt-oss. Check the model’s hosting classification and your credit eligibility before scaling usage. [Supported models](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/inference/details/models/)
2. **Build the infrastructure around inference:** a containerized API and workers on Droplets, PostgreSQL with pgvector for search, and Spaces for files. Those choices give you straightforward migration paths: containers, PostgreSQL exports, and an S3-compatible storage API. [PostgreSQL vector search](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/vector-databases/postgresql/) · [Spaces compatibility](https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/spaces/reference/s3-compatibility/)
3. **Use the credits for evaluations and data processing.** For example, build a document search or extraction pipeline, keep prompts and evaluation cases in your own repository, and compare DigitalOcean-hosted models with other providers through one small adapter in your app.

**My recommendation:** start with serverless open-weight inference plus a portable app stack. Apply for the separate GPU credit only if your measurements show sustained traffic makes self-hosting worthwhile. Also note that serverless inference may require a positive prepaid balance to create a model key; credits restricted to DigitalOcean-hosted models may not satisfy that access requirement. [Prepayment terms](https://www.digitalocean.com/legal/serverless_inference_prepayment)

There is also a distinct **$5,000 inference-only promotion** with different restrictions, so the wording in your award email matters. If you share the credit type and expiry date, I can turn this into a concrete spending plan. [Inference promotion terms](https://www.digitalocean.com/legal/cloud-credits-ai-qualifying-workloads)
